text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Twinkle Star Climax" came to an end 
amidst tremendous fanfare and fervor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The entire audience is cheering for the 
birth of the "strongest" Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>! I'm sorry I couldn't talk with 
you properly earlier!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"I've been hectic with greetings to the 
officials and staff... Now that things 
have settled down, I came to say hello."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Truly... thank you so much for all your 
hard work!!
choice_data_list:
Great work out there as well, Reporter 
Otonashi.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Oh no, not at all!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Without Trainer <username>'s cooperation, this race 
would never have gotten so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Your trainee's great success, granting us 
permission for this close-up coverage, and 
her participation in the race—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
If even one of these were missing, the 
"Twinkle Star Climax" would never have 
been possible.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: So... thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...It's finally starting to sink in that 
the "strongest" Umamusume has been 
decided.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: So it's really been decided, then...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
That may be true. I feel this strange 
sensation, as if I've reached a place 
beyond my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Reporter Otonashi watched the now-empty 
track with a somewhat lonely expression 
after saying that—

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hey Mommy, wasn't that race amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: That's true, she was so cool.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become the strongest Umamusume 
someday too!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
choice_data_list:
It seems the battle is far from over, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed... As long as there are 
Umamusume striving to be the strongest...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
That's right! The race was a huge success, 
so we've got to start planning the second 
one!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! By the time that girl from earlier is 
ready to race, so we can make it an even 
more wonderful race... I intend to push 
forward as a reporter too!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Now, as the cornerstone for the 2nd event, 
let's interview our key contributor first! 
How are you feeling right now!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if the race is over, my dream with <chrname> 
is not.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They made a firm vow to one another to 
keep walking their path hand in hand...!
